editorialDepth.advantages: Falcon2 22W is the value pick in Creality's open-frame line when you want air assist without Pro upsell. Good for mixed wood and dark acrylic experiments.
editorialDepth.limitations: Production shops may still prefer Sculpfun Ultra or LM3 community depth. Photo finesse can trail slower engraving-first modules.
